What it solves: Minted 2026-09-07 by the specifier on QA's unowned-red note, the same
pass (standing-red rule: high at first sighting); register row `unit`
for `extension/test/bridgeServer.test.js` names this ticket, first_seen
2026-09-07. Grepped first: no open ticket names bridgeServer, the
keepalive, or lastSna…
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. What is FIRM: an idle client gets one snapshot, at connect; a real change still reaches every client …
